title: Zero Trust Architecture Principles
concepts: Zero Trust philosophy never trust always verify
learning_objectives: Understand zero trust philosophy and core principles
Implement never trust always verify security controls
Apply identity-centric security with continuous verification

post_assessment.question: What is the core principle of Zero Trust Architecture?
options: Never trust always verify regardless of location
post_assessment.explanation: Zero Trust core principle is never trust always verify treating every access request as potentially hostile regardless of location. Traditional perimeter security assumes internal traffic is safe which fails against insider threats and lateral movement.

content.text: Welcome to Zero Trust! Traditional castle and moat security assumes everything inside the network is trustworthy. But attackers who breach the perimeter move laterally freely. Zero Trust fixes this: never trust always verify every user device and request. This reshapes enterprise security!
